reviewItem.question: Does "When using Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands and upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, make sure the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate is…" mean a change to migration:strimzi|name=stable-connect-identities-strimzipodsets (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: If you use Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 and are upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and switch to StrimziPodSets before upgrading to 0.46.0.
